SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.voucher_date < #{from} THEN e.debit_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS openingDebitSum, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.voucher_date < #{from} THEN e.credit_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS openingCreditSum, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.voucher_date >= #{from} AND v.voucher_date <= #{to} THEN e.debit_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS periodDebitSum, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.voucher_date >= #{from} AND v.voucher_date <= #{to} THEN e.credit_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS periodCreditSum FROM fin_voucher_entry e INNER JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = e.voucher_id AND v.deleted = 0 AND v.status = 'POSTED' AND v.book_id = #{bookId} AND v.voucher_date <= #{to} WHERE e.deleted = 0
AND e.subject_id = #{subjectId}

SELECT s.id AS subjectId, s.code, s.name, s.category, s.direction, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.voucher_date < #{from} THEN e.debit_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS openingDebitSum, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.voucher_date < #{from} THEN e.credit_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS openingCreditSum, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.voucher_date >= #{from} AND v.voucher_date <= #{to} THEN e.debit_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS periodDebitSum, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.voucher_date >= #{from} AND v.voucher_date <= #{to} THEN e.credit_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS periodCreditSum FROM fin_subject s LEFT JOIN fin_voucher_entry e ON e.subject_id = s.id AND e.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = e.voucher_id AND v.deleted = 0 AND v.status = 'POSTED' AND v.book_id = #{bookId} AND v.voucher_date <= #{to} WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.book_id = #{bookId} GROUP BY s.id, s.code, s.name, s.category, s.direction ORDER BY s.code

SELECT id, customer_id AS partnerId, biz_no AS bizNo, biz_date AS bizDate, due_date AS dueDate, create_time AS createTime, amount, settled_amount AS settledAmount FROM fin_receivable WHERE deleted = 0 AND book_id = #{bookId} AND amount - settled_amount > 0.005 ORDER BY COALESCE(biz_date, DATE(create_time)), id

SELECT id, supplier_id AS partnerId, biz_no AS bizNo, biz_date AS bizDate, due_date AS dueDate, create_time AS createTime, amount, settled_amount AS settledAmount FROM fin_payable WHERE deleted = 0 AND book_id = #{bookId} AND amount - settled_amount > 0.005 ORDER BY COALESCE(biz_date, DATE(create_time)), id
